title: Discovery of candidate therapeutic targets with Geneformer
task: Discover therapeutic targets via single-cell transcriptome foundation model
key_results: Geneformer pretrained on >100 million single-cell transcriptomes; in silico perturbation pipeline completes in <2 days on GPU; enables target prioritization with limited experimental data
comments: Practical methodology combining zero-shot inference, fine-tuning and perturbation; scalability advantages offset by dependence on large pretraining corpus.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pretrained embeddings separate phenotypically relevant cell states without task-specific training
hypotheses.result: Zero-shot inference separability assessed; fine-tuning improves context-specific predictions

hypotheses.hypothesis: In silico gene perturbations predict functional therapeutic targets
hypotheses.result: Quantified shifts in cell state embeddings prioritize candidates by statistical and biological metrics

title: A dataset of digital therapeutic device approvals to support regulatory decisions and industry research
task: Construct standardized dataset of approved digital therapeutic devices
key_results: 507 DTx devices identified across US, China, Germany, Belgium with 18 product characteristics
comments: Regulatory compilation rather than experimental research; valuable infrastructure but limited methodological innovation.

title: Blood parameters and whole-blood transcriptomics associated with immune-related adverse events in metastatic renal cell carcinoma during nivolumab plus ipilimumab
task: Identify blood biomarkers and immune transcriptomics associated with immune-related adverse events
key_results: Higher lymphocyte (OR 14.36) and monocyte counts (OR 9.90) associated with irAE risk; five candidate genes (ANAPC1, CDK4, MCM6, GRAP2, BST2) identified; adaptive immune-dominant profile in irAE+ patients
comments: Moderate cohort size (n=51) limits generalizability; transcriptomic markers identified exploratorily without independent validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: High baseline lymphocyte activity predicts irAE development
hypotheses.result: Lymphocyte count OR 14.36; upregulation of lymphocyte/humoral pathways; increased CD8+ T cells and activated memory CD4+ T cells

title: Automated detection of stereotyped animal sounds using data augmentation and transfer learning
task: Deep learning automated detection of stereotyped animal sounds with limited labeled data
key_results: Semi-synthetic augmentation from single exemplar achieves 99.4% recall, 91.2% precision, 95.1% F1 on baleen whale calls; training on consumer-grade hardware in hours
comments: Elegant transfer learning approach reduces annotation burden; exceptional performance on highly stereotyped vocalizations but generalization to less constrained sounds unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Data augmentation from single stereotyped call enables effective training without large labeled datasets
hypotheses.result: Model trained on single example achieves 95.1% F1; matches performance of detectors trained on larger datasets

title: Fixed-point topology meets fractal memory: a Kutumba-stabilized framework for nonlocal fractal–fractional dynamics
task: Develop fixed-point topology framework for fractal-fractional dynamical systems with memory
key_results: Enhanced contraction principles in ANR spaces; Taylor Operational Matrix and adaptive Adams-Bashforth-Moulton schemes; Ulam-Hyers-Rassias stability guarantees; applications to fractional epidemiology and cyber-dynamics
comments: Highly theoretical mathematical framework with abstract existence results; practical computational validation limited and social embedding (Kutumba) appears superficial.

title: Integrative immune subtyping of HNSCC reveals clinically relevant phenotypes and treatment-associated transitions
task: Define immune subtypes of HNSCC and map treatment-associated transitions
key_results: Four immune subtype clusters identified in 1149 tumors; checkpoint inhibition promotes immune activation; chemotherapy enriches immunosuppressive signaling in 44 matched pre/post-treatment samples
comments: Large-scale multi-omics integration with clinical follow-up; dynamic immune state transitions provide actionable biomarkers for treatment selection.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Immune subtypes predict differential treatment response
hypotheses.result: ISC2 (immune-activated) responds better to checkpoint inhibitors; ISC1/ISC4 show distinct chemotherapy sensitivity

title: The effect of medical explanations from large language models on diagnostic accuracy in radiology
task: Evaluate effect of LLM-generated explanation formats on radiologist diagnostic accuracy
key_results: Chain-of-thought explanations improve accuracy 12.2% vs. control (P=0.001), 7.2% vs. standard output (P=0.040), 9.7% vs. differential diagnosis (P=0.004); benefit consistent across case difficulty and physician experience
comments: Rigorous RCT with 2020 assessments demonstrates explanation format significantly impacts clinical decision-making; controlled vignette setting may not generalize to real clinical workflows.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Detailed reasoning explanations improve physician ability to identify and correct LLM errors
hypotheses.result: Chain-of-thought format yields highest diagnostic accuracy; improves error detection vs. standard output

title: Flow matching for generative modelling in bioinformatics and computational biology
task: Apply flow matching generative models to biomolecular and cellular systems
key_results: Flow matching framework enables learning mappings between arbitrary high-dimensional biological distributions; applicable to proteins, DNA/RNA, small molecules, and cell phenotypes
comments: Review article synthesizing theoretical foundations and applications; lacks quantitative validation benchmarks for individual methods.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Flow matching can learn mappings between diseased and healthy cell states
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated applicability in cell biology; open-source implementations available

title: Bioinspired underwater soft robots: from biology to robotics and back
task: Synthesize biological principles guiding underwater soft robot design
key_results: Four design principles distilled: locomotion, compliant morphologies, distributed sensing, adaptive control; bidirectional biology-robotics loop for mechanism validation
comments: Position paper proposing conceptual framework; limited experimental data on specific robotic implementations or quantitative comparisons to biological systems.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Robots can serve as physical models to probe mechanisms difficult to isolate in living animals
hypotheses.result: Bidirectional loop enables mechanistic insights; biouniversal design strategy proposed

title: Physical mechanisms governing generalization and hallucination in deep learning for imaging through scattering media
task: Elucidate mechanisms governing generalization and hallucination in deep learning for imaging through scattering media
key_results: Generalization capacity bounded by ability to accommodate distinct inverse mappings; hallucinations occur when capacity exceeded; residual ballistic light stabilizes predictions; strategic training on diverse physical mappings enhances generalization while suppressing hallucinations
comments: Physics-guided framework provides valuable mechanistic insights; model system (scattering media) is well-controlled but may not capture all complexities of real imaging scenarios.

model_io.model: Deep neural network for inverse imaging through scattering media
inputs: Light transmission matrices with controlled variations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Network generalization is limited by capacity to learn distinct inverse mappings
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via experimental and wave-optics simulation validation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Residual ballistic light acts as stabilizing anchor for robust predictions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; necessary for generalization under scattering variability

title: Towards a general-purpose foundation model for functional MRI analysis
task: Develop foundation model for transferable fMRI analysis across diverse downstream applications
key_results: NeuroSTORM pretrained on 28.65M fMRI frames from 50,000+ participants (ages 5–100); outperforms existing methods on 5 downstream tasks; achieves best diagnostic performance on 17 diagnoses across 2 multihospital cohorts while predicting psychological/cognitive phenotypes
comments: Largest-scale fMRI foundation model to date with impressive transfer learning results; reproducibility and generalization to non-hospital settings remain important future questions.

model_io.model: NeuroSTORM (spatiotemporal foundation model with lightweight task adaptation)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Large-scale pretraining on diverse fMRI data enables transferable representations for downstream tasks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; consistent outperformance across 5 downstream tasks and multihospital cohorts

title: Brain MRI Dataset Featuring a Full Clinical Protocol With and Without Intentional Motion
task: Create motion-corrupted brain MRI dataset for testing motion correction methods
key_results: Dataset of n=22 subjects with paired motion-free and motion-corrupted data across 6 clinical sequences; includes raw k-space data and motion transforms
comments: Small sample size (n=22) limits generalizability, but BIDS-compliance and raw data availability are valuable for method development.

title: Decoding the evolution of melodic and harmonic structure of Western music through the lens of network science
task: Analyze melodic and harmonic evolution in Western music via network topology
key_results: Analysis of ~20,000 MIDI pieces across 6 genres over 4 centuries; network analysis reveals systematic trend toward increasing similarity and reduced complexity in melodic/harmonic structures
comments: Network representation effectively captures genre differences, though causal mechanisms underlying temporal trends remain unclear.

model_io.model: Weighted directed network representation of musical composition

hypotheses.hypothesis: Different genres exhibit distinct topological and musical properties
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; genres show distinguishable network-based signatures

hypotheses.hypothesis: Melodic/harmonic complexity decreases over time across genres
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; systematic trend toward similarity and reduced complexity observed even in Classical and Jazz

title: An optimization method for railway alignment schemes based on game-theoretic combination weighting and an interval number model
task: Select optimal railway alignment schemes via multi-attribute optimization with game-theoretic weighting and interval number model
key_results: 20-indicator evaluation system across 4 dimensions; game-theoretic weighting reduces weight sensitivity; interval number model achieves rankings consistent with design institute recommendation on Jieshipu-Pingliang railway case
comments: Methodologically sound integration of AHP, CRITIC, and game theory, but case study validation on single project limits generalizability.

model_io.model: Multi-attribute decision model (AHP + CRITIC + game theory + interval number distance)
inputs: 20 indicators: technical, economic, environmental, regional development factors

hypotheses.hypothesis: Game-theoretic combination weighting reduces weight factor sensitivity in scheme selection
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; improved robustness demonstrated in case study

title: ES-MOPSO: an energy-aware staged-elite MOPSO system for optimal competition selection in higher education
task: Optimize multi-objective competition selection for higher education students via staged-elite multi-objective particle swarm optimization
key_results: ES-MOPSO reduces skill development variation (CV) by >30%, decreases energy fluctuation by ~10%, achieves better competition scores at equivalent energy cost; outperforms MOPSO, SS-MOPSO, NSGA-II on hypervolume metric
comments: Domain-specific optimization with practical utility; experimental validation limited to representative scenarios rather than diverse student populations.

model_io.model: ES-MOPSO (energy-aware staged-elite multi-objective particle swarm optimization)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-objective optimization with energy-aware modeling improves skill balance and time management
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; CV reduction >30%, energy fluctuation decrease ~10%

title: Contrastive representations of structured treatments
task: Learn unbiased causal effect estimates for high-dimensional structured treatments via contrastive representation learning
key_results: Contrastive approach provably identifies causal factors and discards non-causal factors; achieves unbiased causal effect estimation on synthetic and real-world datasets
comments: Theoretical guarantees are strong, but practical applicability to very high-dimensional treatments (e.g., video) remains to be fully demonstrated.

model_io.model: Contrastive representation learning framework for structured treatments

hypotheses.hypothesis: Blindly leveraging shared structure across treatments can lead to biased causal estimates
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; contrastive learning mitigates this bias by identifying causal factors

title: The convergence of machine learning and data assimilation in Earth system science
task: Review convergence of machine learning and data assimilation in Earth system science
key_results: ML accelerates DA via surrogate modeling; DA provides uncertainty quantification and physical constraints; hybrid DA-ML systems emerging; challenges remain in generalization, consistency, and reproducibility
comments: Timely perspective on synergies between fields; identifies key challenges but limited discussion of specific solutions or implementation best practices.

title: Robust chirality through merging BICs
task: Achieving robust chirality via bound state in continuum merging in planar dielectrics
key_results: Multiple accidental BIC merging produces near-perfect circular dichroism (~0.99) and ultrahigh Q-factor (~10⁴) simultaneously across wide momentum-space region in planar platform
comments: Elegant mechanism combining topological robustness with extreme optical responsivity; practical device implementation and wavelength-scale design details underspecified.

model_io.model: Planar dielectric metasurface with merged accidental BICs

hypotheses.hypothesis: Merging of multiple BICs simultaneously sustains ultrahigh-Q and strong chiroptical response across wide momentum region
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; near-perfect circular dichroism with Q~10⁴

title: Ultra-narrow donor-acceptor nanoribbons
task: Synthesizing donor-acceptor atomically precise nanoribbons via on-surface polymerization
key_results: Co-deposition of peri-xanthenoxanthene (donor) and anthanthrone (acceptor) brominated precursors yields D-A nanoribbons with tunable electronic structure; frontier orbital character matches DFT predictions and simplified LCMO model
comments: Bottom-up synthesis demonstrates unprecedented compositional/sequence control in D-A nanoribbons; optoelectronic characterization limited to STM/AFM electronic structure.

model_io.model: On-surface polymerization of D-A precursors on substrate
Density functional theory (gas-phase) and LCMO model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Monomer sequence in mixed D-A nanoribbons governs frontier orbital character and energetic alignment
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; DFT and LCMO model capture dominant trends in STM/STS

title: Temporal heterogeneity shapes diffusion dynamics in complex networks
task: Modeling non-Markovian diffusion dynamics on complex networks using renewal processes
key_results: Closed-form expressions derived linking node-level temporal statistics to network spectral properties; Gamma-based temporal kernels outperform memoryless models for α-synuclein spreading in mouse brain networks
comments: Provides unified framework for incorporating temporal heterogeneity into network dynamics, though empirical validation limited to single biological system.

model_io.model: Mouse brain network with α-synuclein spreading

hypotheses.hypothesis: Non-Markovian temporal heterogeneity significantly impacts spreading compared to memoryless models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed for α-synuclein spreading; Gamma kernels substantially improved fit

title: Planckian scattering and parallel conduction channels in an iron chalcogenide superconductor
task: Resolving Planckian scattering and parallel conduction channels in iron-based superconductor FeTe1−xSex
key_results: Two parallel conduction channels identified: one broad with weak T-dependence, one sharp with linear-in-T Planckian scattering rate; superconducting condensate drawn primarily from Planckian channel
comments: Time-domain terahertz spectroscopy elegantly separates channels, but mechanistic origin of Planckian scattering remains elusive.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Linear-T resistivity arises from Planckian-limited scattering in one of two parallel channels
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via spectral analysis; superconducting condensate preferentially drawn from Planckian channel

title: Field-induced superconductivity in a magnetically doped two-dimensional crystal
task: Demonstrating magnetic-field-induced superconductivity in dilute-Ce-doped 2D LaSb2 crystal
key_results: In-plane magnetic field suppresses spin fluctuations on Ce sites, enabling anomalous critical temperature enhancement with increasing field; superconducting dome observed in ultrathin LaSb2
comments: Demonstrates field-induced Tc enhancement contrary to Cooper-pair pair-breaking expectations; 2D geometry enables in-plane field manipulation of paramagnetic impurities.

hypotheses.hypothesis: In-plane magnetic field dynamically suppresses spin fluctuations, enhancing superconductivity despite pair-breaking expectations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; anomalous Tc enhancement with field in Ce-doped samples

title: Field re-entrant superconductivity in Eu-doped infinite-layer nickelates
task: Discovering field-induced re-entrant superconductivity in Eu-doped infinite-layer nickelates
key_results: Magnetic-field-induced re-entrant superconductivity observed in Sm0.95−xCa0.05EuxNiO2 with robust zero-resistance state across broad temperature/field ranges; nonlinear Hall transport indicates unconventional mechanism
comments: Extends magnetism-enhanced superconductivity to higher-Tc unconventional superconductors, though deviations from simple compensation model at highest doping warrant further investigation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Eu-derived exchange field compensates applied field to suppress pair-breaking
hypotheses.result: Partially consistent at low doping; pronounced deviations at highest doping levels

title: Engineering thermoelectric performance in copper-doped graphene nanoribbons for energy-aware electronics
task: Engineering thermoelectric performance in copper-doped graphene nanoribbons via defect and dopant control
key_results: Low-concentration Cu doping (especially single-atom) in vacancy-defected armchair GNRs achieves peak ZT >1.5 at room temperature; optimized power factor significantly enhanced while maintaining reduced thermal conductance
comments: Extended Hückel + NEGF formalism provides efficient computational approach, though experimental validation absent and doping stability/realism questionable.

model_io.model: Armchair graphene nanoribbon (AGNR) with vacancy defects and Cu doping

hypotheses.hypothesis: Vacancy defects reduce bandgap and phononic thermal conductance, creating platform for thermoelectric enhancement
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; defect introduction improves ZT via thermal conductance reduction

hypotheses.hypothesis: Optimal Cu doping concentration balances Seebeck coefficient and electrical conductance for maximum ZT
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; low-concentration doping (especially single-atom) peaks at ZT >1.5; high doping reduces Seebeck and efficiency

title: Radioluminescence 3D dose reconstruction for FLASH and conventional radiotherapy
task: 3D dose reconstruction from radioluminescence imaging in FLASH and conventional radiotherapy
key_results: Three reconstruction algorithms (FBAI, FBP, MLEM) validated via Monte Carlo and experiment; experimental gamma-index predominantly <1 across dose rates and field sizes using 9 MeV FLASH and 6 MeV conventional linacs
comments: Promising proof-of-concept for real-time, high-resolution dosimetry at ultra-high dose rates; practical applicability contingent on routine CMOS integration in clinical linacs.

model_io.model: FLASH electron linac (9 MeV) and conventional systems (6 MeV electron, 6 MeV photon)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Radioluminescence-based 3D reconstruction reproduces reference dose distributions across dose rates
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; good agreement with Gafchromic film across conventional and UHDR conditions

title: Toward XRF-like chemical sensitivity in the laboratory: first hyperspectral x-ray imaging demonstration using the novel CITIUS detector
task: Demonstrating hyperspectral X-ray micro-CT with sub-keV energy resolution using CITIUS detector
key_results: CITIUS detector achieves 0.5–0.8 keV FWHM energy resolution with MetalJet laboratory source; Minimum-Residual Basis Material Decomposition separates materials with similar attenuation (water vs. polypropylene) with XRF-like chemical sensitivity
comments: Laboratory-scale hyperspectral imaging closes significant gap to synchrotron XRF, though detector cost and integration remain barriers to clinical deployment.

model_io.model: CITIUS hyperspectral detector with MetalJet source (Ga/In/Sn characteristic lines)
outputs: hyperspectral data (tens of energy bins, 0.5–0.8 keV resolution)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hyperspectral detector with fine energy binning enables laboratory-based material separation comparable to XRF
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; accurate separation of water/polypropylene and element-sensitive imaging achieved

title: COSINUS: a model-independent challenge to the DAMA/LIBRA dark matter claim using cryogenic NaI detectors
task: Model-independent dark matter search using dual-channel cryogenic NaI detectors to challenge DAMA/LIBRA
key_results: COSINUS demonstrates event-by-event particle identification via simultaneous phonon and scintillation readout; planned data taking with 8 modules in 2026 at LNGS facility
comments: Unique dual-channel approach avoids key scintillation-only systematics, though data collection has not yet commenced.

model_io.model: COSINUS cryogenic NaI detector with dual readout

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dual-channel detection enables model-independent cross-check of DAMA/LIBRA signal with moderate exposure
hypotheses.result: Technical feasibility demonstrated; systematic uncertainties mitigated by particle-ID capability

title: A flexible Bayesian framework for atomic masses by locally inferring configuration mixing
task: Developing Bayesian probabilistic nuclear mass model with local configuration mixing
key_results: SPICE model achieves ~500 keV rms deviation with 10-13 parameters via local Bayesian averaging of harmonic-oscillator and spin-orbit excitations; improves extrapolation reliability beyond known nuclei
comments: Parsimonious parametrization with uncertainty quantification valuable for astrophysical r-process calculations, though validation limited to known mass data.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Local configuration mixing improves mass prediction accuracy and extends predictive power to neutron/proton-rich regions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; rms deviation ~500 keV with minimal parameters

title: Sustainability as a challenge in complex systems dynamics
task: Analyzing collective dynamics of infrastructure systems for sustainable development
key_results: Key phenomena identified: flow disruptions, supply fluctuations, non-equilibrium states in electric energy and mobility systems; cross-disciplinary integration emphasized
comments: High-level review lacking quantitative metrics or specific case studies; primarily conceptual framework.

title: Spatiotemporal asymmetries on brain energy landscape uncover system entrapment related to depression severity
task: Identify brain attractor states and state-transition dynamics in depression
key_results: Depressed individuals show reduced transitions between visual-attentional and limbic-default mode configurations; anhedonia correlates with increased frequency but shorter dwell time in salience-dominated states; energetic asymmetries trap brain dynamics between source and sink attractors
comments: The energy landscape framework elegantly captures depression as a dynamical systems problem, though causal relationships between structural connectivity changes and altered transition probabilities remain to be established.

model_io.model: resting-state fMRI + diffusion-weighted structural connectivity integration

hypotheses.hypothesis: Anhedonia is associated with altered visitation patterns to salience-dominated configurations
hypotheses.result: More frequent, shorter-lived visits to salience state in anhedonic individuals

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cognitive rigidity in depression reflects constrained state-transition dynamics
hypotheses.result: Reduced transitions between visual-attentional and limbic-default modes; preference for energetically costly trajectories despite structural alternatives
